title: What Will ₹100 Buy in 2046? The ₹ Time Machine (Inflation Explained)
description:
This ₹15 cup of tea could cost about ₹48 in 2046 (at an assumed 6% inflation a year). What will your ₹100 buy?
Try the ₹ Time Machine free: https://moneyviel.com/money-tools/inflation-calculator/

Step into the ₹ Time Machine: watch everyday prices (tea, school fees, rent, a wedding, a family car) travel from 2026 to 2036 to 2046, play 3 pause-and-guess rounds, learn the Rule of 72 shortcut, and see what it all means for your goals. All figures use an assumed 6% inflation a year: an example, not a forecast.
